description: This file defines the VertexAIBatchPrediction class, which handles batch prediction operations with Google Vertex AI, including creating, retrieving, and listing batch jobs, with support for asynchronous operations.

classes.name: VertexAIBatchPrediction
classes.description: A class for managing batch prediction jobs on Google Vertex AI, supporting creation, retrieval, and listing of batch jobs, with both synchronous and asynchronous methods.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the VertexAIBatchPrediction with a GCS bucket name.

methods.name: create_batch
methods.description: Creates a batch prediction job, supporting async operation.

methods.name: _async_create_batch
methods.description: Handles asynchronous creation of a batch prediction job.

methods.name: create_vertex_batch_url
methods.description: Constructs the URL for Vertex AI batch prediction jobs.

methods.name: retrieve_batch
methods.description: Retrieves the status or result of a batch prediction job, supporting async operation.

methods.name: _async_retrieve_batch
methods.description: Handles asynchronous retrieval of a batch prediction job.

methods.name: list_batches
methods.description: Lists batch prediction jobs with optional pagination, supporting async operation.

methods.name: _async_list_batches
methods.description: Handles asynchronous listing of batch prediction jobs.
